episodeTitle.en: Nickey Skarstad (Airbnb, Etsy, Shopify, Duolingo) on translating vision into goals, operationalizing product quality, second-order decisions, brainstorming, influence, and much more
episodeTitle.zh: 尼基·斯卡斯塔德（曾任Airbnb、Etsy、Shopify、Duolingo产品总监）将探讨如何将愿景转化为目标、产品质量的运营化、二阶决策、头脑风暴、影响力等诸多议题。

guestBioOfficial.en: Nickey Skarstad is a Director of Product Management at Duolingo, where she is leading a stealth 0 → 1 product. Prior to Duolingo, she was VP of Product at The Wing, Product Lead at Airbnb, where she led much of the Experiences product team,  Product Lead at Shopify, and Director of Product Management at Etsy.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 尼基·斯卡斯塔德现任Duolingo产品管理总监，此前曾在The Wing担任产品副总裁、Airbnb产品负责人（负责大部分体验产品团队）、Shopify产品负责人以及Etsy产品管理总监。

title.en: Nickey Skarstad (Airbnb, Etsy, Shopify, Duolingo) on translating vision into goals, operationalizing product quality, second-order decisions, brainstorming, influence, and much more
title.zh: 尼基·斯卡斯塔德（曾任Airbnb、Etsy、Shopify、Duolingo产品总监）将探讨如何将愿景转化为目标、产品质量的运营化、二阶决策、头脑风暴、影响力等诸多议题。

summary.en: Nickey walks through setting vision, translating it into goals, and executing with alignment, plus how to run effective product review sessions. She shares the skills that powered her rise from forum moderator to director of product. The episode is a grounded playbook for turning strategy into shipped, high-quality product.
summary.zh: 尼基逐步讲解了如何设定愿景、转化为目标并对齐执行，以及如何开好产品评审会。她分享了让自己从论坛版主一路成长为产品总监的本领。本期是一份扎实的手册，关于如何把战略变为已交付、高质量的产品。
